title: Faithfulness of the geometric stalk functor over a field
statement: For any field K and algebraically closed K-extension Omega, the geometric stalk functor on Type max(u,v)-valued etale sheaves is faithful.

proof.text: For each point of an etale object lift it to Omega with exists_fac_of_etale_of_isSepClosed. Equality of stalk maps gives equal germs. Point.toPresheafFiber_eq_iff' supplies a pointed refinement with equal restricted sections. Factor that refinement through an arrow of the equalizer sieve written as ofArrows. Its image contains the original point, so ofArrows_mem_smallEtaleTopology_iff makes this sieve covering. Sheaf.isSeparated gives equality of the section values; hom extensionality proves equality of morphisms.
